sloka: सर्व लोक प्रियम् त्यक्त्वा सर्व लोक हिते रतम् ।सर्व लोको अनुरज्येत कथम् त्वा अनेन कर्मणा ॥२-५८-३२॥
transliteration: sarva loka priyam tyaktvā sarva loka hite ratam ।sarva loko anurajyeta katham tvā anena karmaṇā ॥2-58-32॥

translations.english: 'How can anyone in this world be pleased with you for deserting Rama, the beloved of all, and ever devoted to their welfare?
